scripts.build:win-x64: node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:win-arm64: node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --target aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.build:mac-arm64: node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:linux-x64: node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles appimage
scripts.build:linux-x64-v3: node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-cpu=x86-64-v3' CFLAGS_x86_64_unknown_linux_gnu='-march=x86-64-v3' tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles appimage
scripts.build:linux-arm64: node scripts/fetch-sidecars.mjs --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles appimage
scripts.check: tsc -b --noEmit && cd src-tauri && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test
